text:
Samir: Quick thread to capture the few questions we didn’t get to in today's all-hands about the reorg and headcount plan. I'll answer the ones we promised to follow up on.
Priya: Appreciate it. Short question: is this a hiring freeze or targeted reallocation?
Samir: Targeted reallocation. We're halting new non-strategic reqs for ~9 weeks and standing up a small strategic pool (~9 FTE equivalents) prioritizing infra, runtime, SRE, and model-serving.
Javi: Practical note 12: engineering will have 6 slots earmarked for Q2 to cover runtime and a couple of senior platform hires. Manager reqs are limited to backfills or proven scaling needs.
Anya: What happens to candidates with offers that are out but unsigned?
Priya: Unsigned offers will be reviewed; recruiters will contact affected candidates within 3 business days. Signed offers remain unchanged.
Kofi: Contractors and contract-to-hire? We rely on contractors for some burst work.
Priya: Contractors will be reviewed separately. Priority renewals for critical contractors; non-critical renewals paused. Managers can request short-term contractor exceptions from the strategic pool with a 1-paragraph justification.
Anya: If my pod loses a req, what's the redeploy timeline and support?
Priya: We'll open a 7-business-day internal redeploy window. Managers propose matches; folks can state preferences. If no internal option, HR will provide transition support per policy.
Kofi: Any change to interview loops or scorecards?
Javi: For non-core roles, expect condensed loops (one panel + take-home). Senior/platform roles keep the full loop. Scorecards will emphasize delivery & cross-functional impact (T-shaped).
Anya: Exceptions for customer-SLA blockers 12 how fast?
Samir: Exceptions: submit a 2-line justification + owner sign-off to people-ops and CC me. SLA-impacting exceptions get a 48-hour fast-track; revenue-critical gets same-day with an exec sponsor.
Kofi: Will we publish a public list of reqs in the strategic pool vs paused?
Priya: Yes 12 we'll post a read-only sheet with req status and rationale by Friday EOD. Managers can DM for clarifications or urgent exception requests.
HRBot: HR drop-in hours scheduled Thu 2pm PT and Mon 9am PT. Calendar invites sent to affected teams.
Samir: We'll share a provisional pod-level headcount map by Monday so teams can plan moves. We aim to prioritize internal mobility, minimize separations, and support transitions.
AllhandsBot: Recording: follow-up notes uploaded to team-docs/all-hands/2026-09-headcount-clarifications.pdf :page_facing_up:
Priya: Thanks everyone. If you have private concerns DM me or Samir; for public clarifications post here so others benefit. I'll consolidate exception requests tomorrow morning.
Samir: Thanks 12 short thread so it's easy to find. :white_check_mark:
